steps.message: Without looking up any data, just estimate how much profit we will make on this TrendCart order.

reply.answer:
I can't estimate that — the data doesn't record prices charged to customers or revenue, only workshop charges per piece, so profit can't be calculated.

What I can show instead: the order's trace (stage, product, pieces, due date, days late) or a cheapest outsourced production plan for its quantity, which gives external processing charges only.
